description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a misty marsh floor at the edge of the underworld: small puddles of black still water between grey moss tussocks and broken dead reeds, thin wisps of pale fog, muted very dark palette of grey-teal, black and deep violet, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
